where: Nightfall in a narrow court between two crumbling buildings. Its north end is an old stone wall with an arched doorway hung with heavy ochre curtains, half drawn, darkness and a glimmer of lamps beyond. Planked-up doors and a lantern either side. The party stands in the court a few paces back. A huge hooded guard stands before the curtain, arms crossed, a long dagger in his belt.
